name: Alba Ferrer Soler
headline: Analytics engineer: dbt models, tests, and Looker dashboards for operations teams
summary: Six years turning operational data into reporting that retail and logistics teams rely on. I build and test dbt models on BigQuery, put Looker on top, and agree metric definitions with the managers who use them.

experience.title: Senior Data Analyst
bullets: Rebuilt weekly sales reporting as dbt models on BigQuery, cutting preparation from 2 days to 3 hours a week.
Added dbt tests to the 25 most used models; incidents reported by managers fell from about 10 a month to 2.
Moved 40 Excel reports to Looker dashboards used by 120 store and regional managers.
Mentored 2 junior analysts on SQL and code review.

experience.title: Data Analyst
bullets: Built a Python (pandas) forecast of daily parcel volumes per depot; forecast error fell from 18% to 11%.
Wrote the SQL behind the operations KPI pack sent to 6 regional directors every Monday.
Automated driver-shift reports with Python and Airflow, saving about 5 hours a week.

experience.title: Junior BI Analyst
bullets: Cleaned and documented a customer database of about 30,000 records before a CRM migration.
